title: Result ready compact Region review
scope: Completed Agent result surface in narrow Regions

evidence.observation: Result ready sometimes grows to roughly ten rows in a small Region, cannot be closed, and its buttons can be unreachable, blocking normal work.
evidence.risk: A completion summary becomes an unbounded obstruction instead of an optional review entry.

evidence.observation: All changed files and preview URLs render as wrapping buttons in a permanently mounted flex strip with no dismiss or height bound.

decision.surface: Use a single compact summary row by default with explicit expand, collapse and dismiss controls.
decision.details: Show files and previews in bounded, scrollable, grouped lists with reachable actions at narrow widths.

acceptance: The default Result ready surface occupies one compact row in a narrow Region.
Expand exposes every review target in a bounded list; collapse and dismiss restore the Region without blocking input.
The visible controls remain reachable by pointer and keyboard at narrow widths.
